name: 66226 · Shawnee, KS
findings: ZIP 66226 (Shawnee) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66226 (Shawnee) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 66226 (Shawnee) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 43% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
